capabilities: Render month, week, day and agenda views from one code block
Create and edit events, tasks, recurrence and colors
Drag to reschedule, resize and copy events
Navigate and edit the grid by keyboard
Copy the visible period as Markdown text
disambiguation: Not a date-picker or daily-note calendar; it renders a full event and task calendar inside one code block.
extras: Stores all data as JSON inside one note; invalid hand-edited JSON shows an error with a Reset block button. Optional status bar item shows the next upcoming entry. Interface follows Obsidian's language (English or Russian). MIT licensed, author mrrepac.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, so scheduling events and tasks inside notes requires external tools or scattered note files.
summary: Calendar plugin that renders month, week, day and agenda views from a single Markdown code block holding JSON data.
